chunks: You are surely calling them to the right path.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be called to the straight path in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as affirming the Prophet Muhammad's role as the perfect exemplar of the straight path (Sirat al-Mustaqim), which is subsequently linked to the Ahl al-Bayt as the guides who maintain this path after him. It underscores the clarity and accessibility of divine guidance, contrasting the Prophet's sincere invitation with the varied responses of humanity. This reinforces the concept that true guidance is not merely theoretical but is embodied in the Prophetic and Imamic tradition.
